name: stepper
description: Horizontal or vertical progress indicator for a multi-step process. Shows which steps are complete, which is current, and which remain. Also known as Progress Steps.

intent.horizontal: Connectors stretch to fill available width; labels sit inline right of each indicator. Best for 3-7 steps in a full-width header.
intent.vertical: Connectors run down the left edge with a 16px minimum, giving a 40px step pitch. Best for side panels, narrow columns and mobile.

steps.notes: Ordered. Labels read best at 1–3 words.

currentStep.notes: 1-based. currentStep={2} makes the second step current. Status is DERIVED from this — never passed per step, so complete/current/upcoming cannot contradict each other. A value above steps.length marks every step complete.

onStepClick.notes: When provided, complete and current steps render as buttons. Upcoming steps stay non-interactive — a user cannot skip ahead. Without it, steps are plain text.

connector.notes: Colour is driven by the PRECEDING step's status, not the following one.

focus.notes: focus-visible only, and only when onStepClick is set.

stepper/border.notes: Aliases a PRIMITIVE directly. The inherited ruleset forbids that for component tokens; Accura treats the component tier as another semantic layer and permits it. No semantic carries this value with the right meaning — color/border/default (#e4e4e7) is invisible against the #f4f4f5 fill, and color/border/hover / color/input/border mean hover state and input boundary.
stepper/border.figma: DOES NOT EXIST IN FIGMA — code-only. A token re-export will not regenerate it.

composition.child: li — aria-current='step' on the active one
composition.notes: Not composable — driven entirely by the steps array. There is no exported StepperItem.

behavior.statusDerivation: index + 1 < currentStep -> complete; === currentStep -> current; > currentStep -> upcoming
behavior.state: None. currentStep is fully controlled by the caller.

typeGuide.complete: Step is done. Filled brand indicator with a check; the connector leaving it is brand-coloured.
typeGuide.current: Step in progress. White indicator with a 2px brand ring and a brand number; label is semibold.
typeGuide.upcoming: Not started. Muted indicator and secondary label; not clickable even when onStepClick is set.

accessibility.role: ol / li — an ordered list is the correct semantic for a sequence
accessibility.label: aria-label on the ol, default 'Progress'
accessibility.statusText: Each step carries visually hidden status text (', completed' / ', current step' / ', not started') so the number is never announced alone
accessibility.icon: Check icon is aria-hidden — the status text carries the meaning
accessibility.keyboard: Only when onStepClick is set: Tab moves between clickable steps, Enter/Space activates

constraints: 3–7 steps horizontally — beyond that labels crowd; switch to vertical
Labels of 1–3 words; long labels break horizontal alignment
Upcoming steps are never clickable, even with onStepClick
bestPractice: Use for a known, ordered, finite sequence — approval flows, onboarding, checkout. It communicates position in a process, not completion percentage; use Progress for that. Prefer vertical in side panels, narrow columns and on mobile.

meta.auditRules: not audited — code-only component, no Figma set
openQuestions: No Figma component set exists. If design needs to own this, build the set and record its node ID here.

stepper/border exists only in code — tokens/components.tokens.json and accura-ui/src/app/tokens.css. If the Components collection is ever re-exported from Figma it will be dropped. Add it to Figma to make it durable.
notes: Built for Accura 2026-09-08. Not inherited from Agentic — shadcn/ui has no stepper, so this is custom like Item and Sidebar.

Verified in-browser at build time: indicator 24px / radius 9999px; current #ffffff fill, 2px #008852 border, #008852 number, #18181b semibold label; upcoming #f4f4f5 fill with #52525b number and label; connectors #e4e4e7. Vertical label-to-indicator offset measured at 0px across all steps.

2026-09-08: upcoming indicator gained a 2px ring. color/border/default was tried first and measured invisible against the muted fill; the value moved to zinc/300 via the new stepper/border component token.
Status is derived from currentStep rather than passed per step. This is deliberate — it makes an impossible state (two current steps, a complete step after an upcoming one) unrepresentable.
The connector belongs to the step it leaves, so its colour reflects the preceding status. Colouring it from the following step puts the brand line one position late.
Vertical alignment: the label wrapper is h-6 to match the indicator, and step pitch comes from the connector's min-height. Adding padding to the label instead squeezes the text to the top of its box.
